text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Assad briefed on Lebanese Prime Minister Hariri's U.S. visit, coordination discussed.
- Al-Bassel power station, co-financed by Kuwait, inaugurated by Prime Minister Zu'bi and visiting Kuwaiti Deputy Premier Rodhan.
- Syrian-Libyan cooperation discussed by interior ministers.
- Vice-President Khaddam confers with Ukraine delegation.
- Kuwaiti minister voices support for Syria.
- Jewish settlement in Israeli-occupied Golan to be expanded, moves underway.
- Egypt foreign minister: we strive to rescue peace process.
- Palestinians report progress in Hebron talks with Israel.
- Foreign ministers of the Damascus Declaration (Syria, Egypt and the the six-nation Gulf Cooperation Council) to meet in Cairo on Saturday.
